title: Symmetric difference of four sets
statement: For any set type with decidable equality and any four finite subsets $S_0,S_1,S_2,S_3$, their tuple symmetric difference equals $S_0\mathbin{\triangle}(S_1\mathbin{\triangle}(S_2\mathbin{\triangle}(S_3\mathbin{\triangle}\varnothing)))$.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying type has decidable equality
